import json,subprocess,tomllib
from pathlib import Path
base='3147536c1833102f21e5291dd7b403ee886e1c84'
sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
source=['sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-asterdex/src','sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-asterdex/tests']
paths=source+['sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-asterdex/scripts','sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-asterdex/Cargo.toml','packages/safe-cex/src/exchanges/asterdex','packages/safe-cex/src/exchanges/base.ws.ts','packages/safe-cex/src/exchanges/base.ts','packages/safe-cex/src/types.ts','packages/safe-cex/src/store','packages/safe-cex/src/utils','packages/logging/src','sdk-rs/parity/manifest/exchanges/asterdex','sdk-rs/Cargo.toml','sdk-rs/.cargo','.cargo','rust-toolchain.toml','sdk-rs/rust-toolchain.toml','infra/tradetunnel/src/frames.rs']
local=['safe-cex-candle-cache','safe-cex-crypto','safe-cex-exchange','safe-cex-num','safe-cex-store','safe-cex-transport','safe-cex-types','safe-cex-venue-asterdex']
for crate in local[:-1]:paths.extend([f'sdk-rs/{crate}/src',f'sdk-rs/{crate}/Cargo.toml',f'sdk-rs/{crate}/build.rs'])
checks=[]
for name,scopes in [('source_and_tests',source),('extended_inputs',paths)]:
 argv=['git','diff','--exit-code','--quiet',base,sha,'--',*scopes];r=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,capture_output=True)
 checks.append({'name':name,'argv':argv,'exit':r.returncode,'output':r.stdout+r.stderr})
 assert r.returncode==0,(name,r.stdout,r.stderr)
def packages(data):return {(p['name'],p['version'],p.get('source','')):p for p in data['package']}
old=packages(tomllib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':sdk-rs/Cargo.lock'],text=True)))
new=packages(tomllib.loads(Path('sdk-rs/Cargo.lock').read_text()))
def closure(pkgs):
 root=[k for k in pkgs if k[0]=='safe-cex-venue-asterdex'];assert len(root)==1
 pending=root[:];seen=set()
 while pending:
  key=pending.pop()
  if key in seen:continue
  seen.add(key)
  for dep in pkgs[key].get('dependencies',[]):
   parts=dep.split();matches=[k for k in pkgs if k[0]==parts[0] and (len(parts)==1 or k[1]==parts[1]) and (len(parts)<3 or k[2]==parts[2].strip('()'))]
   assert len(matches)==1,(dep,matches);pending.extend(matches)
 return {k:pkgs[k] for k in seen}
a,b=closure(old),closure(new)
assert a==b,'Reachable Asterdex lock graph changed'
assert sorted(k[0] for k in a if not k[2])==local
changed=[list(k) for k in old.keys()|new.keys() if old.get(k)!=new.get(k)]
record={'measured_sha':sha,'compared_code_gate_sha':base,'integration_parent':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD^2'],text=True).strip(),'diff_checks':checks,'reachable_asterdex_lockfile_graph_exit':0,'reachable_local_packages':local,'raw_lockfile_changed_packages':changed,'comparison_script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'claim':'Source/tests, extended source inputs and reachable Asterdex lockfile graph unchanged. Cargo gates measured at original code SHA; not rerun at merge SHA.'}
Path('/tmp/asterdex-order-merge-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Merge SHA',sha,'integration parent',record['integration_parent']);print('Source/tests diff exit0; extended inputs exit0; reachable lock graph exit0; raw lock changes',changed)
claim: Source/tests, extended source inputs and reachable Asterdex lockfile graph unchanged. Cargo gates measured at original code SHA; not rerun at merge SHA.
